eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 无账号 · 一条命令

headline.zh:
把 coding agent 出的 HTML
洗成公众号能接住的可编辑 HTML
headline.en:
Wash coding-agent HTML into
公众号-editor-pasteable, in-place-editable HTML

sub.zh: 不用回 agent 改一个字 —— 贴进公众号编辑器就地改；带 noscript / video / template / form 的 deck 也洗得过去，空了、怪了也不装成功。
sub.en: No re-running the agent to tweak one word — paste and edit in place in the 公众号 editor; decks with noscript / video / template / form wash clean too, and empty or weird input never fakes a green ✓.

title.zh: 带 noscript / video / template / form 的 deck，也洗得过去
title.en: Decks with noscript / video / template / form wash clean too

body.zh: 以前只要 deck 里带了 noscript、video、template 或 form 这几类标签，洗到一半就崩 —— 抛错退出，一个字的输出都不留，整篇 deck 洗不了。现在这几类标签都洗得干净：平台不收的外壳剥掉，该留的正文照留，每次都能拿到一份能贴的输出。
body.en: If a deck carried noscript, video, template, or form tags, the wash used to die mid-run — a traceback, zero output, the whole deck unwashable. Now those tags wash clean: the platform-incompatible shell is stripped, the visible body survives, and you get a pasteable file every time.

chips: › noscript / video / template / form 都洗得过去
› 不再中途崩、不出空文件

title.zh: 改字体的时候，背景图和 CSS 不再被顺手截断
title.en: Remapping fonts no longer truncates your backgrounds and CSS

body.zh: 如果一个元素同时挂了非白名单字体和 data-URL 背景图，以前改字体会顺手把背景图的 url( 截断、把后面的 CSS 全丢掉 —— 贴进去背景图就没了。现在改字体只动 font-family 这一句，其余样式原样保留，data-URL 背景图和相邻 CSS 都完整过缝。
body.en: If one element carried both a non-allowed coding font and a data-URL background, the font remap used to slice the url( open, truncate the data URL, and drop every CSS declaration after it — your background vanished on paste. Now the remap touches only font-family and leaves the rest of the style verbatim, so data-URL backgrounds and adjacent CSS survive intact.

chips: › data-URL 背景图不再被截断

title.zh: 撞到问题，一条命令打开 issues 提反馈
title.en: Hit a snag? One command opens issues to file feedback

body.zh: clone 下来用，撞到问题想报，以前得自己翻 issues 地址、想该写什么。现在跑 gzhseam feedback，浏览器直接打开项目 issues 页，预填模板要你填的全是关键字段 —— 版本、系统、那段输入 HTML、你跑的命令、期望和实际差在哪 —— 一分钟提一个高信号 issue。
body.en: You cloned it, hit a snag, and filing meant digging for the issues URL and guessing what to include. Now run gzhseam feedback — your browser opens the project issues page, and the prefilled templates ask for exactly the fields that make a high-signal report: version, OS, the input HTML, the command you ran, what you saw vs expected. File a useful bug in under a minute.

chips: › 预填模板要的全是关键字段
› 一分钟提一个高信号 issue

title.zh: 空了就告诉你空了 —— 不再泄外壳、不再装成功
title.en: Washes to nothing? It says so — no wrapper leak, no fake success

body.zh: 喂一份只剩 head 级标签（script / style / meta / title / link）的 deck，以前洗完会留一坨空的 <html><head></head></html> 外壳 —— 贴进去就是没用的脚手架；喂一份空的或纯空白的 deck，还会写一个 0 字节文件、打绿勾 —— 你以为洗好了，一贴啥也没有。现在这两种都老实了：只剩 head 标签的洗完是空片段、不带外壳；空的或洗后无残留的直接红 ✗ 退出、不写空文件。非 UTF-8 的 deck、-o 指到不存在的目录、手滑跑了 init / auth login，也统一是这条干净的红字 —— 告诉你卡在哪、该怎么往下走，不再被一坨报错栈吓住。
body.en: Feed a deck that's only head-level tags (script / style / meta / title / link) and the wash used to leave the empty <html><head></head></html> wrapper in the output — useless scaffolding you'd paste. Feed an empty or whitespace-only deck and it wrote a 0-byte file with a green ✓ — looked done, pasted nothing. Now both are honest: a head-only deck washes to an empty fragment with no wrapper, and an empty or fully-stripped deck fails cleanly with a red ✗ and writes no file. A non-UTF-8 deck, an -o pointing at a directory that doesn't exist yet, or an accidental init / auth login all get the same clean red line — telling you where it's stuck and how to move on, instead of a wall of traceback.

chips: › 只剩 head 标签的 deck 不再泄外壳
› 空输入红 ✗ 退出、不写空文件
› 非 UTF-8 / 缺目录 / init-auth 都是一条红字

headline.zh: agent 把生成做便宜了，瓶颈在贴进去这层缝
headline.en: Agents made generation cheap — the bottleneck is the paste seam

sub.zh: GzhSeam 接的就是这层缝。一条命令，deck.html → 公众号能接住的可编辑 HTML；撞到问题就 gzhseam feedback。
sub.en: GzhSeam fits exactly that seam. One command: deck.html → 公众号-pasteable, editable HTML; hit a snag and gzhseam feedback opens issues.

tag.zh: MIT 开源 · 一条命令的缝
tag.en: MIT open source · a one-command seam
